# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

She aiküa's ahe Tupá, Nde japó hagüe, roikua'a hagüa, haro Tupu'itu hagüa.
 Aiküa'a avel koaga, la she kangy ha, ha Nde, Nde mbaretéha, Ha she Mboriahuó, ha Nd, Nde riko ha.
 Ndaí pori ambu'éishagüa, Nandejara, Nde inoite pytyvóhára roimé ya'í javé, Nde inoite reikó Nde jehevé.
